event: 44th PCA General Assembly racial reconciliation actions
method_note: The PCA's official 2016 summary says 43 overtures dealt with racial reconciliation. This file accounts for that total as 39 overtures answered by reference to amended Overture 43, plus Overture 43 itself, Overture 45 creating the racial/ethnic reconciliation study committee, Overture 44 from Potomac Presbytery creating the PCA Unity Fund through MNA, and Overture 60 from the Session of Auburn Road Presbyterian Church answered by reference to Overture 43.

main_action.title: Pursuing Racial Reconciliation and the Advance of the Gospel
main_action.notes: Used by the Overtures Committee as the framework, incorporating elements from Missouri Overture 4, Northwest Georgia Overture 53, and Mississippi Valley Overture 55.
